Card Q&A.a: Yes, you delete 1 of their level 6 or lower Digimon.
Card Q&A.q: If the "if they have 4 or fewer cards in their hand," condition in this card's [On Deletion] effect is met, do I delete 1 of my opponent's level 6 or lower Digimon even if the "if" condition in the 1st process isn't met?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Deletion] If your opponent has 5 or more cards in their hand, they trash 1 card in their hand. Then, if they have 4 or fewer, delete 1 of their level 6 or lower Digimon.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
